sloka: विश्रुतः त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च ।पितृ व्रतत्वम् सत्यम् च त्वयि धर्मः च पुष्कलः ॥३-६-९॥
transliteration: viśrutaḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaśasā vikrameṇa ca ।pitṛ vratatvam satyam ca tvayi dharmaḥ ca puṣkalaḥ ॥3-6-9॥

translations.english: You are renowned in the three worlds for your valour, for your devotion to father, and in you lies enough evidence of your adherence to truth and righteousness.
